maya: Quick heads-up — ran a quantized bring-up of open-mosaic-3b-staging and noticed chat templates sometimes drop the system prompt entirely. Repro steps below.
maya: repro: start convo with role system -> user, then response comes out as if no system prompt existed.
maya: minimal repro in the tokenizer REPL:
maya: ```python
maya: from transformers import AutoTokenizer
maya: t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('open-mosaic-3b-quant')
maya: t.convert_tokens_to_ids(['[BOS]', '[PAD]', '[SYSTEM]'])
maya: # => [50257, 0, 50257]
maya: ```
jon: whoa — PAD and BOS collapsed to same id? that's suspect. Did the conversion script reassign ids after added_tokens.json merge?
maya: I think so. The HF->Redwood conversion we ran did a vocab concat + added_tokens merge. I found an entry in added_tokens.json that's just a zero-width space "\u200b" and the script seems to normalize tokens before deduping.
samir: zero-width space -> normalization can make it collide with empty or existing pad token representation. If PAD key is empty string in some tokenizers, dedupe could map them together.
jon: do we have a quick dump of special tokens mapping from the conversion tool?
maya: pasted below (from our conversion log):
maya: ```
maya: special_tokens: {"bos_token": "<|bos|>", "pad_token": "", "eos_token": "<|eos|>"}
maya: added_tokens: ["\u200b", "<|system|>", "<|user|>"]
maya: post-merge map: {"<|bos|>":50257, "":50257, "<|system|>":50257}
maya: ```
jon: yikes. So pad_token is empty string in that model, and zero-width-space got normalized to empty, then deduped to BOS id.
samir: that explains the chatfmt drop — system prompt token id overlaps BOS so prefix caching/kv logic drops the system segment at runtime when the runtime treats identical ids as control tokens.
samir: quick mitigation: explicitly set pad_token to '<|pad|>' during conversion and reindex added_tokens without normalizing invisible characters.
maya: I ran a patch locally: `conversion --force-special-map pad:<|pad|> --keep-invisibles` and the token ids become distinct. Chat template now preserved in the same convo.
jon: can you attach the conversion command and the small unit test that fails before/after? we'll add it to the onboarding CI.
maya: added a tiny unit test in the PR description (link in ticket). Failing assertion checks that system prompt token ids are unique and that prefix kv shape doesn't shrink unexpectedly.
token-bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 — "ghost-pad zero-width merge causes chat template drop on quantized imports" (assignee: samir) :spiral_note_pad:
samir: I'll pick up the conversion fix tomorrow. Short-term: revert the quantized model on staging until we push the patched conversion.
jon: ack. tagging infra to revert the staging instance :eyes:
maya: thanks — leaving logs and the small repro in the ticket. We'll also add an assert in the HF->Redwood converter to error on invisible-token collisions.
jon: love that. :thumbsup:"
